user.title: Weather Integration Setup
user.description: Choose a weather data source and a station for measured pollen. You will choose the weather location in the next step.

data_description.pollen_station: Choose the pollen measuring station independently of the weather station and warning postcode. This choice does not change the modelled pollen forecast location. You can change it later in Configure.
data_description.data_source: Choose measured weather from a MeteoSwiss station or Open-Meteo weather for coordinates. Both use MeteoSwiss ICON Seamless forecasts through Open-Meteo.

meteoswiss.title: MeteoSwiss STAC Setup
meteoswiss.description: Select a Swiss weather station and the postal code used for weather warnings.

data_description.postal_code: Four-digit Swiss postal code for natural-hazard warnings only. It does not select the weather forecast location or pollen station.
data_description.station_id: Supplies measured temperature, wind and rain. Choose the ICON weather forecast location next. Modelled pollen, air quality and UV keep the Home Assistant home coordinates.

openmeteo.title: Open-Meteo Setup
openmeteo.description: Enter the base coordinates for current weather, modelled pollen, air quality and UV. Choose the ICON weather forecast location next; warning postcode stays separate.

data_description.postal_code: Four-digit Swiss postal code for natural-hazard warnings only. It does not select the weather forecast location or pollen station.
data_description.latitude: Base latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84, -90 to 90). Used with longitude for current weather, modelled pollen, air quality and UV. The weather forecast location is chosen next.
data_description.longitude: Longitude of the same weather location in decimal degrees (WGS84, -180 to 180). These coordinates do not change the warning postcode or the measured-pollen station.

forecast_location.title: Weather forecast location
forecast_location.description: Current forecast location: {current_location}. Choose a postcode, town or POI for ICON weather forecasts and forecast sensors. Observations, modelled air quality/pollen/UV, measured pollen and warning postcode keep their separate locations.

data_description.action: Keep the current location, search the official catalogue, or explicitly return to the original base coordinates. No location changes until you confirm.

forecast_search.title: Find a forecast location
forecast_search.description: Search by four-digit Swiss postcode or a town/POI name, for example 8302, Säntis or Gotthardpass. The search is local to the official MeteoSwiss catalogue. This selects weather forecasts, not warning coverage.

data_description.query: Enter 2–128 characters. Accents and ae/oe/ue spellings are supported. Narrow a broad search until at most 20 results remain.

forecast_select.title: Select the forecast point
forecast_select.description: Choose the intended point explicitly. Labels show name, point category, catalogue height above sea level and coordinates. Stations and same-named POIs are different forecast points.

data_description.point: Check category and height. A postal-code point is an assigned forecast coordinate, not a post office or your exact home address. No result is preselected.

forecast_confirm.title: Confirm the forecast location
forecast_confirm.description: Forecast location: {location}. Warning postcode stays {postal_code}; this does not establish warning coverage for the selected POI. Only ICON forecasts and forecast-derived sensors/HGT change. Current observations and other source locations stay unchanged. Submit to apply.

data_description.search_again: Enable to return to search without saving. Otherwise submit to confirm the displayed location.

error.invalid_postal_code: Enter a four-digit Swiss postal code, for example 8302.
error.invalid_pollen_station: Select a pollen measuring station from the list.
error.invalid_forecast_selection: Choose a valid forecast location from this dialog. An invalid saved selection must be replaced or reset to the base coordinates.
error.invalid_forecast_query: Enter 2–128 characters: a four-digit postcode or a town/POI name.
error.forecast_catalogue_unavailable: The location catalogue is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or cancel; the saved location is retained.
error.forecast_no_matches: No matching forecast point. Check the spelling or try another postcode/name.
error.forecast_too_many_matches: More than 20 matches. Enter a more precise name or postcode.

abort.already_configured: This data source and location are already configured.

init.title: MeteoSwiss locations and stations
init.description: Choose the weather measuring station, measured-pollen station and forecast location together. Current forecast location: {current_location}. The warning postcode is independent. Search opens further steps; nothing is saved until you submit the final choice. Updates are automatic.

data_description.station_id: Supplies measured weather values. Changing it keeps the existing entities; their readings follow the new station from this change onward.
data_description.pollen_station: Only measured pollen changes. Modelled pollen and air quality keep their base location.
data_description.postal_code: Four-digit Swiss postcode for warnings. This does not select the weather station or forecast point.
data_description.forecast_action: Keep the displayed forecast point, search by postcode/town/POI, or return to the original base coordinates. A forecast search postcode does not change the warning postcode.
data_description.latitude: Base coordinates for Open-Meteo current data, modelled air quality/pollen/UV and a forecast without an explicit point. An explicitly chosen forecast point remains independent.
data_description.longitude: Base coordinates for Open-Meteo current data, modelled air quality/pollen/UV and a forecast without an explicit point. An explicitly chosen forecast point remains independent.

forecast_search.title: Find a forecast location
forecast_search.description: Search by four-digit Swiss postcode or a town/POI name, for example 8302, Säntis or Gotthardpass. The search is local to the official MeteoSwiss catalogue. This selects weather forecasts, not warning coverage.

data_description.query: Enter 2–128 characters. Accents and ae/oe/ue spellings are supported. Narrow a broad search until at most 20 results remain.

forecast_select.title: Select the forecast point
forecast_select.description: Choose the intended point explicitly. Labels show name, point category, catalogue height above sea level and coordinates. Stations and same-named POIs are different forecast points.

data_description.point: Check category and height. A postal-code point is an assigned forecast coordinate, not a post office or your exact home address. No result is preselected.

forecast_confirm.title: Confirm the forecast location
forecast_confirm.description: Apply these choices together: weather/current data {station}; measured pollen {pollen_station}; forecast {location}; warning postcode {postal_code}. A forecast POI does not establish warning coverage for that POI. Submit to save all pending changes, or cancel to retain the previous settings.

data_description.search_again: Enable to return to search without saving. Otherwise submit to confirm the displayed location.
